tasks.title: Validate subscription settings and persist securely deletable subscriber state
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, R3 settings/store/cleanup and R9 validation, R10 stored inventory/retention and R5 subscribers delete implementation (dispatch comes in T4); D7/D18, store/cleanup/settings/operator-deletion checks and corresponding counterexamples. Pin the merged contract full SHA here. Supply independent injectable settings, store and CLI components; production service wiring waits for T4.

acceptance.expected: 0 failing tests; focused coverage may fail its threshold, so no focused exit-0 requirement. R3 settings default to off and ignore subscription settings then; on requires named variables, bounds MAX/MAX_PENDING with pending <= total, SMTP and secret rules, and 63/65-character or uppercase keys fail without values. R9 accepts an origin with/without slash and refuses /pulse and /pulse/ with the exact fixed line before secret/store/lock/listener I/O. Store uses version 1, WAL/FULL/secure_delete, mode 0600 and its own lease lock; refuses other versions; every mutation is transactional; persists passes and next_pass_at without changing the channel ledger.

Startup cleanup precedes requests. Prune settled/seeded events only after the retention period and only if absent from last good listedIds; prune nothing before first good read and never prune pending events. Deletion cascades deliveries, deleted address bytes are absent from the live database, WAL size is 0 after checkpoint; busy checkpoints warn without addresses and retry on cleanup; shutdown checkpoints.

CLI reads only state-path and lock settings and works with subscriptions off. Executable dispatch is completed/tested in T4.

exit 0; lint, typecheck, all tests and 80% full-suite line coverage pass with the new components independently testable. Existing main behavior/ledger suites remain green. README/configuration/operation document the new settings, exact R9 root-hosting sentence, data inventory, retention and stopped-service deletion. AGENTS names new components and corrects current ledger format 3 to 4 (preserve format 5 if #570 has merged); no ledger/config-file format changes.

Public projections only: drafts/private notes/internal incidents and leaked explicit private flags give 0 events/sends, later publication gives exactly 1 per eligible address, repeated content keys do not resend.
